QUOTE: "`check_approval` only consults the allow list." and "approved = auto_approve || is_explicitly_allowed(allow list)" with "The allow list only skips the approval step. It never overrides deny, schema, or tier checks."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list only skips the approval step and doesn't override deny. It also says it is consulted only in `check_approval` (tool_executor.cpp:161), while deny is checked in server_manager.cpp, so the different-file point is shown.
